message: turmoil_net::kernel::tests::bind_different_protocols_can_share_port asserts nothing - it can only fail by panicking

why: three bare trigger().await calls, no unwrap and no assert; trigger returns (), so a non no-op (suspending on an empty barrier set) hangs the test forever rather than failing it, and the file's own timeout import gives the fix.
